$comment: Pins the vendored HyperFrames engine + agent skills. Treat like a lockfile: update via `npm run engine:install` (npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --full-depth), never hand-edit compositions or engine internals. This records what the pipeline was built/tested against.

toolkit.$comment: The HyperFrames capabilities this pipeline relies on, mapped to the diagram's engine box.
toolkit.reframe: aspect-ratio reframing (16:9 <-> 9:16) — used for short-form delivery
toolkit.graphics: HTML/CSS card + motion compositions (lower-thirds, top cards, callouts, lists, stats)
toolkit.captions: HyperFrames embedded-captions skill (we also ship a fast ASS caption path)
